text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.2569 for the Software Engineer / SRE position. Their strongest evidence includes experience with "Kubernetes" for containerisation and devops, as well as "Django" for scripting. Key gaps include missing must-have requirements for aws, spring, infrastructure as code, and ci/cd. Despite the low fit, missing must-have skills, and a location mismatch, the application has been escalated for further review.
